correctness.rationale: A fresh random permutation of centers -1,0,1 under quadratic component steps x↦qx+(1-q)c yields the exact epoch IFS X↦q^3X+(1-q)^2 D with six equiprobable digits D={-1-q,-1,-q,q,1,1+q}. The hull radius is (1-q^2)/(1+q+q^2); adjacent digit gaps are q,1-q,2q,1-q,q. Comparison to 2q^3(1+q)/(1-q^3) proves first-generation hulls are strictly disjoint iff q<q_sep root 1-q-3q^3-q^4=0, and IFS support fills its hull iff q>=q_fill root 1-q^2-2q^3=0. The central gap persists below fill; standard strong-separation formula applies only below sep. Independently enumerated permutations and exact rational gaps for multiple q, bracketed both roots and verified stationary variance identities.
